What interior
work includes

Everything below is planned, priced
and built by our own crew.

  • LVP floors

    Waterproof luxury vinyl plank for any room.

  • Tile floors

    Porcelain and ceramic tile, laid flat and level.

  • Painting

From estimate
to finished room

How interior work runs,
step by step.

  1. 01

    Visit and estimate

    We measure, bring samples and send a written estimate.

  2. 02

    Materials ordered

    Flooring, paint and wallpaper ordered for your rooms.

  3. 03

    Prep and protection

    Furniture moved and covered, floors protected, old flooring out.

  4. 04

    Install and paint

    Floors laid, walls painted or papered, built‑ins finished.

  5. 05

    Cleanup and walkthrough

    Furniture back in place, then a final walkthrough together.
